test_title: SSC GD Constable Previous Year Paper (Held on: 17th November 2021 Shift 2)
subject: general
question: Select the most appropriate option to fill in the blank no.2.
solution:
The correct answer is: **for**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• It is in context to the fact that the author has received awards**for **public speaking.
 
• The preposition 'for' is used to talk about a reason for something.
 
 
• ​For example: I won an award **for** my writing skills.
 
 
 
• In this case, the reason why the author has received awards is because of public speaking.
 
• The rest of the prepositions are contextually incorrect.

Therefore, the correct answer is: I am a confident speaker and have won prizes **for** public speaking.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Let's understand the other options:

 
• ​The preposition **"on" **is used to indicate that someone is giving attention or focusing on something. 
 
• The preposition** "by"** is used to indicate the means or method through which something is done. 
 
• The preposition **"of"** is used to indicate possession or belonging.
